google-baseball.title: Play Google Baseball Online for Free - Fun Baseball Doodle Game
google-baseball.slogan: Hit a home run with Google Baseball!
google-baseball.description: Step up to the plate and play Google Baseball! This engaging Google Baseball doodle game lets you experience the thrill of batting. Enjoy retro visuals and addictive gameplay in Google Baseball. Play now for free!

HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Time your swing to hit the ball as far as possible in Google Baseball.
